caption:
The video captures a woman performing a slow dance routine in a mirrored studio. She wears a pink cropped top, black shorts, black socks, and a translucent purple sash. Seen at a side angle facing the mirror, she holds a round yellow hand-fan on a stick near her head with her right hand. Her left arm extends forward during these opening moments. As she rotates her torso, the fan shifts around her head, alternating between a face-on disc and a thin edge-on line. Her left arm sweeps upward, and she transitions into a bent-knee stance facing the camera.

During this lower stance, the fan remains in her right hand, held low before she brings it across her body. The prop then is raised high overhead by her left hand. She extends her right arm forward, pointing the fan outward while her left arm reaches back. She holds a pose with one leg extended and toe pointed, while her mirror reflection tracks every movement in sync.
